text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — QBR for AtlasPay is in 2 weeks. Need final slide slate, preread 1-pager for execs, and a short demo checklist. Who can own slide consolidation?
Devon: I can own consolidation. Can we split by section? I’ll need all slide drafts by Friday EOD.
Oliver: I’ll take the exec preread (1-pager + key asks). Will prep an "ask" slide and the one-pager notes.
Priya: Account health note — onboarding lag for new tenants, spike in provisioning errors last week. Renewal risk flagged ~7/10 for this account. We should include a mitigation plan + timeline on the risk slide.
Ankit: Demo checklist (draft):
```
- Demo env: atlaspay-sandbox (prod-masked creds)
- Personas: finance admin + platform engineer flows
- Happy path: end-to-end invoice ingestion -> embed -> match
- Known flaky step: webhook retry (have fallback script)
- Rollback: revert feature-flag and redirect traffic
- Recording + transcript enabled
```
DeployBot: Reminder: Calendar slot for customer-facing demo must be reserved before dry-run.
Maria: OK assigning owners — Devon: slide consolidation & slide deck assembly; Oliver: exec preread (1-pager); Priya: health + mitigation slide + metrics; Ankit: demo checklist + dry-run ops. Everyone please: add action items to the QBR board, upload slides to /qbr/atlaspay by Thu EOD, and ping me once uploaded. :thumbsup:
Devon: Noted, will start a round-robin for slide authors and ping owners.
Priya: I’ll add the onboarding metrics and a short RCA summary — will flag any blockers.
Ankit: Will schedule a dry-run for Friday and include the rollback drill.
Maria: Thanks — keeping this thread as the single source for asks. If anything changes, mention @Maria.
